Chapter 575 - Whale

Chapter 575 - Whale

The last breath he took in the Ancient Dream Realm was now spreading through his body.

Incredibly, this ancient aura strengthened his body and soul.

“This…. The damage taken within the Ancient Dream Realm is reflected in reality. Items within it can be taken out as well?”

Zhao Feng’s mind was blown.

Although the Ancient Dream Realm seemed extremely realistic, Zhao Feng had only entered with his consciousness. From his point of view, it was basically an illusion.

However, the result was incredible. Zhao Feng realized that the Ancient Dream Realm wasn’t just a simple mental energy world.

Miao miao!

The little thieving cat jumped onto Zhao Feng’s shoulder and started to absorb part of the ancient aura that seeped out.

After all, Zhao Feng’s body couldn’t fully absorb the aura, so the remaining part was absorbed by the little thieving cat.

Miao miao!

The little thieving cat seemed to be extremely excited after absorbing the ancient aura.

“This aura seems to help me a lot.”

Zhao Feng closed his eyes.

Firstly, his bloodline seemed to have been cleansed and strengthened. This usually only happened when someone had a qualitative breakthrough. For example, from the Ascended Realm to the True Spirit Realm, one’s state of existence would change.

“My body and bloodline have both become stronger.”

Zhao Feng gently punched and felt that his body was more powerful than before.

The most obvious change was his bloodline power. The aura of his bloodline was purer now, and it even had signs of “tracing back to its ancestor.”

Bo~

A ripple of water surrounded Zhao Feng and the energy was purer than ever.

“An aura from the ancient era….”

The Ice Imperial Spear trembled slightly, and the coldness sealed within it started to awaken. Zhao Feng seemed to hear a voice. This was probably the weapon spirit within the Earth-Grade inheritance weapon.

Earth-Grade weapons were items only below the Heaven-Grade, and it wasn’t rare for them to have spirits.

“The Ice Imperial Spear is slightly incomplete, but it seems to have recovered and strengthened a bit now.”

Zhao Feng found that the Ice Imperial Spear could also absorb a wisp of the ancient aura from the Ancient Dream Realm.

Such changes made Zhao Feng surprised and overjoyed.

Just a tiny breath from the Ancient Dream Realm had so many uses. The little thieving cat, his Earth-Grade weapon, and Zhao Feng himself all benefited from it.

Three days later, Zhao Feng’s injuries were healed, and he entered the Ancient Dream Realm once more.

This time, Zhao Feng managed to last five breaths, and within those five breaths, Zhao Feng absorbed twice as much ancient aura than before.

Hu~

Zhao Feng tried his best to fully absorb it.

This aura upgraded the attributes of his body and seemed to change his very state of being. His bloodline power also became purer.

Miao miao!

The little thieving cat sat on Zhao Feng and quickly absorbed the aura from the Ancient Dream Realm.

“Source of True Spirit!”

Zhao Feng’s eyes lit up as he made some of the Ancient Dream Realm aura enter his Source of True Spirit.

He was once again surprised. When his Source of True Spirit absorbed the ancient aura, Zhao Feng’s power of Wind Lightning, including the Purple Destruction Lightning, was cleansed and became purer.

Of course, these increases were all very miniscule and could only be sensed when one focused. However, Zhao Feng was still overjoyed. This aura was extremely effective for everything.

Like this, Zhao Feng entered the Ancient Dream Realm three more times, and the maximum amount of time he lasted was eight breaths.

Of course, the longer he stayed in, the more serious his injuries and the longer he would need to recover.

Three times later, Zhao Feng’s body and bloodline had strengthened dramatically.

He felt that every inch of his body contained immense power, and, within just a short month, his body was comparable to some Sovereigns.

His Source of True Spirit became purer as well.

“If this continues, I’ll be able to break through to the peak True Lord Rank soon.”

Zhao Feng was full of expectation. Due to the fact that his mental energy level had already reached the level of a Sovereign, once he reached the peak True Lord Rank, he would instantly ascend to the half-step Origin Core Realm.

Sou~~ Di! Da!

The Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship passed through the ocean like a fish.

Boom~~~~

At a certain moment in time, an enormous and powerful aura appeared in front of the ship.

“Not good, there seems to be a very strong beast in front of us.”

Loulan Zhishui sent commands to the sailors in the control room, and Zhao Feng was also disturbed.

The aura ahead was stronger than most Sovereigns, and from the sound of it, it seemed to be a large animal.

“Let me see.”

Zhao Feng opened his God’s Spiritual Eye.

Shua!

An enormous whale several miles wide came into view.

This whale was definitely the largest animal Zhao Feng had ever seen. Just by splashing around, it could create dozen-mile-wide waves that could flood cities.

“This is one of the biggest animals in the ocean – the limitless ocean whale!”

Loulan Zhishui exclaimed and her face went white as she saw the image that Zhao Feng sent her.

“Limitless ocean whale? The legendary beast? Apparently, when it’s mature, it’s battle-power is at least comparable to a Sovereign.”

The sailors in the ship were shocked and quickly cooperated with Loulan Zhishui.

Shua!

Zhao Feng sealed the power of his eye once more and his expression became solemn.

The limitless ocean whale was far too big, and its lifeforce was extremely strong. Even Sovereigns couldn’t deal with it.

“Go around it, quick!”

Loulan Zhishui and the sailors tried their best to evade the area.

Boom~~~ Boom~~~~

The whale surged over and its body created deep thuds.

In front of this whale, the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship was just a tiny dot.

Peng~

The Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship was tossed around in the ocean, and everyone on the ship lost their balance.

“Skeletal Division Leader!”

Zhao Feng roared.

“Yes, Master.”

The skeletal Division Leader appeared and blocked a wave in front of them. This wave was enough to kill normal True Lord Ranks, but the skeletal Division Leader’s bones were extremely tough after merging with the Nine Deadly Yin Bone, so it could block the head-on attacks of Sovereigns.

“Set the formation!”

The skeletal Division Leader waved the black flag and the power of the curse started spreading.

Hu~~

Over eighty ghost-corpses appeared in the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array, and the power of the curse had reached an incredulous level.

In the blink of an eye:

Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!

The power of the curse turned into hundred-yard-long snakes and dragons that attacked the limitless ocean whale.

Shu~~~~

Even something as strong as the limitless ocean whale had its lifeforce depleted as it was eroded by the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array.

Wu~~

The limitless ocean whale roared and shook the ocean.

“What strong lifeforce! Even a normal Small Origin Core Realm wouldn’t be able to last ten breaths against the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array.”

Zhao Feng was stunned. The limitless ocean whale was enormous, and its lifeforce was countless times stronger than other Sovereigns.

In terms of battle-power, several normal Sovereigns definitely wouldn’t be its match.

Pi! Pa! Boom~~~~

The skeletal Division Leader used the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array mainly to protect the ship as it fought with the limitless ocean whale.

At the beginning, the skeletal Division Leader had no advantage at all, but as time passed, the limitless ocean whale’s lifeforce kept being eroded and absorbed by the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array.

An hour later, the several-mile-wide whale was severely weak and couldn’t fight back against the skeletal Division Leader anymore.

“Zhe zhe zhe…. Eating this big blockhead is much better than devouring several Sovereigns.”

The skeletal Division Leader waved the black flag. At this moment in time, blood started to seep out of the whale’s enormous body, and its body was becoming skin and bones.

When the sailors within the ship saw this, they felt a chill in their bones.

The Ghost Corpse Cursed Array had reached a terrifying level.

“Eighty-two cursed ghost-corpses.”

Zhao Feng nodded his head.

Boom~~~ Boom~~~ Boom~~~

Right at this moment, roars and enormous splashes sounded one after another.

Hmm?

Zhao Feng’s God’s Spiritual Eye twitched.

Not good!

The skeletal Division Leader felt a huge surge of auras, none of them any weaker than the whale in front of them.

One… two… three…

In just a short moment, the skeletal Division Leader sensed almost ten limitless ocean whales, and the number was still increasing, causing it to jump up in fright.

One had to know that the battle-power of each whale was comparable to the late-stage Small Origin Core Realm, and they were extremely hard to kill.

“Retreat! We’ve probably met a horde of them.”

Zhao Feng exclaimed.

The skeletal Division Leader didn’t dare to fight anymore. It immediately put away the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array.

Gulu~~

The Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship travelled at its fastest speed as it charged toward the surface.

“As long as we leave the ocean, we’ll be safe.”

Zhao Feng and company all knew this. The ocean was the whales’ territory, and the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship could travel faster in the sky.

Bam! Bam!

The Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship took on the brunt of a couple attacks.

More than a dozen enormous figures closed in on the tiny ship.

Sou!

In the nick of time, the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship dodged the mouths of several whales and managed to enter the air.
